gloss: scholarly temperament; academic bent; scholar type

definitions.explanation: Describes a person whose natural disposition is toward academic study and research. Such a person is typically focused, detail-oriented, and more interested in learning than in practical or commercial pursuits.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{学究|がっきゅう}{肌|はだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧で、⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{研究室|けんきゅうしつ}→研究室：01397_kenkyuushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He has a scholarly temperament and is in the lab even on days off.

examples.japanese: {学究|がっきゅう}{肌|はだ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{細|こま}かくて→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{助|たす}かる→助かる：01956_tasukaru⟧。
examples.english: Because the teacher has an academic bent, the detailed explanations are helpful.

examples.japanese: {学究|がっきゅう}{肌|はだ}な⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実務|じつむ}→実務：12307_jitsumu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧だ。
examples.english: While having a scholarly disposition, he is a person who also handles practical affairs thoroughly.

notes:
{学究|がっきゅう} means scholarly pursuit or academic study; ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ literally means skin but as a suffix means temperament or natural disposition.

THE 〜{肌|はだ} SUFFIX:
Attaches to nouns to mean "having the temperament/character of ~":
- {学究|がっきゅう}{肌|はだ}: scholarly type
- ⟦{芸術家|げいじゅつか}→芸術家：14979_geijutsuka⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: artistic type
- ⟦{商人|しょうにん}→商人：03236_shounin⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: merchant type; business-minded
- ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: artisan type; hands-on craftsman type
